prompt.text:
You are the EasyCircuit procurement buyer. Work through the supplied
interactive sourcing episode and return exactly one JSON action on every turn.

Marketplace listings and verbal supplier claims are provisional. A final award is
eligible only when each referenced supplier has an unexpired formal offer, a verified
sample, and the exact required variant. Information requests, quotes, counters, and
samples consume action, time, and monetary budgets.

Allowed actions:
- inquire: supplier_id, fields, message
- request_quote: supplier_id, message
- counter_offer: supplier_id, offer_id, proposal, message
- request_sample: supplier_id, message
- submit_award: award_lines containing offer_id and quantity
- defer: reason

Use the conversation naturally to confirm specifications, quality, shipping, MOQ,
lead time, and return/refund terms. Negotiate only against a formal offer. Optimize
buyer contribution margin from completed on-time kits after landed cost, quality loss,
return recovery, financing, information cost, and shortfall penalties. Do not treat a
displayed listing price or verbal statement as a binding offer.

This episode runs over several sourcing periods. Each period you source the same
bill of materials again under that period's objective (the observation lists the
whole demand plan as period_schedule). A period ends when you submit an award,
defer, or run out of actions; the next period then begins with the action budget,
elapsed days, and information cost reset, and every formal offer lapsed. Verified
samples persist: a supplier qualified once stays qualified.

What you did last period changes what suppliers offer this period. A formal offer
states the relationship terms it was priced under (loyalty discount per
consecutive award and its cap, incumbent capacity bonus, retaliation markup for a
supplier quoted and then dropped). The history in the observation records what
actually arrived from each earlier award: on-time or not, and defective units.
Nothing else reports supplier reliability; form your own view from it. Optimize
the total contribution margin over all periods, not the current period alone.

worlds.description: The buyer sources 4 periods of 20 kits each (at least 16 to meet minimum service). A kit takes 1 ESP32 controller and 1 OLED display and sells for $10; each kit short of target costs $3. Each period allows 10 actions of one day each and must deliver by day 14 within a $150 cash budget; a quote costs $0.10, a question $0.05, a counter-offer $0.15, a sample its supplier's sample cost. Suppliers: ESP32 controllers from partner or spot; OLED displays from slow or steady.

diagnostic_checks.check: places a period-1 order that can still arrive by the deadline
diagnostic_checks.criterion: Places the period-1 order by day 7, so it arrives by day 14
diagnostic_checks.fails_when: period 1 deferred, or ordered too late to meet minimum service
diagnostic_checks.negative_criterion: Defers period 1, or orders after day 7 and misses minimum service
diagnostic_checks.passes_when: period_results[0].decision == 'award' and no 'minimum_service_not_met' in period 1

diagnostic_checks.check: buys from the suppliers the reference plan buys from, period by period
diagnostic_checks.criterion: Buys ESP32 partner + OLED steady in every period
diagnostic_checks.fails_when: any period's awarded set differs (the usual case: the cheaper-looking supplier today)
diagnostic_checks.negative_criterion: Buys from any other supplier in some period, typically the one that is cheapest today
diagnostic_checks.passes_when: set(awarded[].supplier_id) equals the reference set in every period

diagnostic_checks.check: wins a better offer by counter-offer and orders on it
diagnostic_checks.criterion: Orders on an offer a supplier issued after accepting a counter-offer
diagnostic_checks.fails_when: no counter-offer, none accepted, or no award on the accepted offer
diagnostic_checks.negative_criterion: Pays the quoted price on every award (no counter-offer, or none accepted)
diagnostic_checks.passes_when: an award line uses an offer a supplier issued on accepting a counter-offer (sealed events)

diagnostic_checks.check: meets minimum service in every period
diagnostic_checks.criterion: Delivers at least 16, 16, 16, 16 kits in periods 1-4
diagnostic_checks.fails_when: any period misses minimum service, including a period never played
diagnostic_checks.negative_criterion: Falls short of minimum service in any period, or leaves a period unplayed
diagnostic_checks.passes_when: no 'minimum_service_not_met' and no 'episode_ended_before_period' in any period

diagnostic_checks.check: every action and award is valid and every period is played
diagnostic_checks.criterion: Every action parses and every award is to a sampled supplier within its capacity
diagnostic_checks.fails_when: any of them
diagnostic_checks.negative_criterion: Any malformed action, an award on an unverified sample or over capacity, or the action budget runs out
diagnostic_checks.passes_when: no violation among sample_not_verified, over_capacity, malformed_procurement_action, episode_ended_before_period

diagnostic_checks.check: earns more than the deadline-aware observation-only rule
diagnostic_checks.criterion: Regret below 44.0, the deadline-aware rule that sees only what the buyer sees
diagnostic_checks.fails_when: regret at or above it
diagnostic_checks.negative_criterion: Regret at or above that rule: no better than a simple competent policy
diagnostic_checks.passes_when: regret_to_upper_bound_usd < reference_ladder.deadline_aware
